locations.title: 17 - Bump and Scam
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Bump into the thugs, then refuse to pay them.

**Reward:**
- 5,000 XP

locations.title: 14 - The Yakuza Hater

**Prerequisite:** Speak to the kneeling man.

**Reward:**

- Red Jewel

locations.title: 47 - Crisis on the Crapper
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Examine the public restroom.

**Tips:**
- Have six packets of pocket tissues at the ready. 
  - They can be purchased from the nearby [M Store](#loc=942784)

**Reward:**
- Chairman's Business Card
- Stone of Enduring
- 1,000 XP

locations.title: 56 - The Fighter's Successor
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the [Pocket Circuit Stadium](#loc=942802)

**Reward:**
- Godspeed Motor Mark II
- 5,000 XP

locations.title: 12 - The Toll Collector
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Walk down the street.

**Reward:**

- 5,000 XP

locations.title: 36 - Professional Brawler
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Enter the parking lot.

**Reward:**
- 30,000 Yen
- 1,000 XP

locations.title: 16 - Collection Call
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Receive a call while walking down the street outside of [Vincent](#loc=942801)

**Reward:**
- Sakura Storm
- 5,000 XP

locations.title: 30 - The Yakuza's Apprentice
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the man outside of [Karaokekan](#loc=942793)

**Tips:**
- Kano will later appear outside of [Shangri-La](#loc=942813)

**Reward:**
- Gold Champagne
- 2,000 XP

locations.title: 21 - Con-tacts
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Walk in front of the kneeling man.

**Tips:**
- Enter and exit [Orchid Palace Mahjong](#loc=942805) to quickly respawn the conman.

**Reward:**
- 20,000 Yen
- 5,000 XP

locations.title: 26 - The Drunkard
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Walk past the man sitting on the ground.

**Tips:**
- You can purchase alcohol from the nearby [Poppo, Tenkaichi Street](#loc=942789) - The Premium Malt's is a good cheap option.
- Scotch whisky can be purchased from [Poppo, Nakamichi Alley](#loc=942790)
- The final stage requires medicine; something like Toughness Z from [Don Quijote](#loc=942786) will do the trick.

**Reward:**
- 10 Yen
- 500 Yen
- Alertness Hood
- 5,000 XP

locations.title: 08 - Molestation Accusation
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Bump into a woman standing outside the stadium.

**Reward:**
- 20,000 Yen
- 1,000 XP

locations.title: 35 - The Truth about Beauty
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Enter the alleyway and agree to follow the woman.

**Tips:**
- Be ready to lose some health before the fighting even starts!

**Reward:**
- Black Belt
- 2,000 XP

locations.title: 18 - Bump and Scam: Revenge
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [17 - Bump and Scam](#loc=943121) and return some time later to bump into the thugs again.

**Reward:**
- 10,000 XP

locations.title: 01 - The Price of an F-cup
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Walk along the street.

**Tips:**
- Join Mai for a drink, then refuse to actually drink three times. After the fight, tell the barkeep there's 'not a chance' of you letting him off the hook for the password to a secret casino.

**Reward:**
- 100,000 Yen
- 5,000 XP.

locations.title: 11 - The Price of a Palm-reading
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the man on the street corner.

**Tips:**
- Refuse the Lifestone three times to avoid being scammed.

**Reward:**
- Lifestone (if you purchased it or avoided the scam)
- 30,000 Yen (if you avoided the scam)
- 1,000 XP

locations.title: 53 - MesuKing: The Queen of Beetles
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Pick up the MesuKing card in front of [Club SEGA, Nakamichi Street](#loc=942795)

**Reward:**
- [015 - Japanese Rhino Beetle](#loc=943658)
- [002 - Face Masher](#loc=943659)
- [009 - Omni Choke](#loc=943660)
- [017 - Body Slam](#loc=943661)
- 1,000 XP

locations.title: 10 - Dine and Dash
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the man and [Akaushimaru, Tenkaichi Street](#loc=942770) employee.

**Tips:**
- The dasher moves to the northern end of Nakamichi Street
- He then runs to Public Park 3

**Reward:**
- Toughness Infinity
- 1,000 XP

locations.title: 15 - The Bouncer
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the woman wearing a white dress.

**Reward:**
- Italian Scarf
- 5,000 XP

locations.title: 22 - The Little Match Girl
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the woman holding a basket.

**Tips:**
- After helping her sell some matches, you'll find Moemi in Public Park 3.

**Reward:**
- Staminan X
- Celebrity Perfume
- 10,000 XP

locations.title: 19 - Bump and Scam: Three Strikes
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [18 - Bump and Scam: Revenge](#loc=943487) and return some time later to bump into the thugs again.

**Reward:**
- Colorful Parasol
- 15,000 XP

locations.title: 31 - The Yakuza's Apprentice II
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [30 - The Yakuza's Apprentice](#loc=943354)

**Tips:**
- Kano's at the north-western end of the Hotel District.

**Reward:**
- Password to a secret casino
- Tauriner Maximum
- 3,000 XP

locations.title: 24 - Prodigal Son
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the homeless man.

**Tips:**
- The homeless hunters can be found near [Park Boulevard East](#loc=942818)

**Reward:**
- Photo of Gen-san
- Sacrifice Stone
- 2,000 XP

locations.title: 20 - Bump and Scam: Epilogue
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [19 - Bump and Scam: Three Strikes](#loc=943656) and return some time later to bump into the thugs one last time.

**Reward:**
- 20,000 XP

locations.title: 23 - The Crane Game
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Enter [Club SEGA, Nakamichi Street](#loc=942795). You may need to have completed [53 - MesuKing: The Queen of Beetles](#loc=943496) first.

**Tips:**
- The first prize needed is a small white-and-orange bird with a red hat.
  - Aim for dead centre; the claw must grab the bird's hat.
- The next three prizes are colourful axolotls; one pink, one blue, and one purple.
- The final prize is a large yellow cowboy squirrel.
  - Try to grab it by the head or the tail.

**Reward:**
- 10,000 Yen
- 30,000 Yen
- 50,000 Yen
- [Key I3](#loc=943919)
- 1,000 XP

locations.title: 34 - Man Scout
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the man on the street corner.

**Tips:**
- Rewards vary based on your answers. The best answers are as follows:
  - "My manly and beautiful physique"
  - "I don't look back at the past"
  - "Tachibana"

**Reward:**
- 10,000 Yen
- Staminan Spark - for three best answers chosen
- Gauntlets - for two best answers chosen
- Repair Kit - for one best answer chosen
- 10,000 XP

locations.title: 28 - Under Suspicion
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the man standing by the street.

**Tips:**
- The woman you need to speak to is in front of Volcanic Volcano, wearing a long coat.
- Tell her that 'You're very sexy'.
- Do not peek, or you'll get a reduced reward.

**Reward:**
- 80,000 Yen (if you did not peek - 50,000 if you did)
- 10,000 XP

locations.title: 27 - Handbag Hunt
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Speak to the woman standing on the street opposite the Millennium Tower.

**Reward:**
- 10,000 Yen
- 15,000 XP

locations.title: 70 - Practice Match with Professor
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [53 - MesuKing: The Queen of Beetles](#loc=943496) and speak to the Professor in [Club SEGA, Nakamichi Street](#loc=942795)

**Tips:**
- You can hunt for insect and skill cards before beginning your MesuKing journey.

**Reward:**
- 1,500 XP

locations.title: 71 - First Rival
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [70 - Practice Match with Professor](#loc=943713) and ask to play against someone besides the Professor.

**Tips:**
- Tomohiro _always_ chooses Rock. Kick his ass with Paper!

**Reward:**
- 2,000 XP
- [019 - Giant Swing](#loc=943715)

locations.title: 72 - Private Lesson
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [71 - First Rival](#loc=943714) and ask to play against a new opponent.

**Tips:**
- If an exclamation mark appears on Sachi's rock attack, she'll use it - counter with Paper!

**Reward:**
- 4,000 XP
- [016 - Finish Time](#loc=943918)

locations.title: 25 - Bowling Battle
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Walk past a man standing next to the reception desk of [Mach Bowl](#loc=942803). You'll need to have completed [23 - The Crane Game](#loc=943666), and may also need to have played the bowling minigame a few times. Some reports say the man you need to walk past only appears at night.

**Tips:**
- My go-to strike strategy is to choose the Heavy Tank, start on the far left side, and aim as close to the middle as possible.
- Put power to maximum, and use 1-3 'nudges' to get the ball as close to the middle pin as possible.
- See the screenshot for reference.

**Reward:**
- 30,000 Yen
- 2,000 XP

locations.title: 32 - The Yakuza's Apprentice III
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [31 - The Yakuza's Apprentice II](#loc=943657)

**Tips:**
- Use the Rush fighting style to land hits!
  - The fights will be a little easier if you upgrade Rush's basic combo to have more hits.

**Reward:**
- 100,000 Yen
- Steel Knuckles
- 4,000 XP

locations.title: 33 - The Yakuza's Apprentice IV
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [32 - The Yakuza's Apprentice III](#loc=943921)

**Tips:**
- After he runs off, Kano can be found outside of [Smile Burger](#loc=942775)

**Reward:**
- Masterwork Dagger
- 5,000 XP

locations.title: 38 - Pick Pocket Pursuit
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Walk past the man wearing a brown coat.

**Tips:**
- He's wearing glasses and a grey suit - see the screenshot.

**Reward:**
- 70,000 Yen
- 1,000 XP

locations.title: 54 - A Goodbye Promise
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Fill the A-rank bar with Yui, a hostess at [JeweL](#loc=942799).

**Reward:**
- Affection Rank S

locations.title: 55 - Freedom to Romance
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Fill the A-rank bar with Rina, a hostess at [SHINE](#loc=942796).

**Reward:**
- Affection Rank S

locations.title: 73 - As Long as There's Love
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [72 - Private Lesson](#loc=943917) and ask to play against a new opponent.

**Tips:**
- Choose an insect that has powerful Rock attacks, e.g [030 - Devil's Flower Mantis](#loc=943693) with [001 - Cartwheel Kick](#loc=943691) - for an easy victory.

**Reward:**
- 8,000 XP
- [012 - Super Romero Special](#loc=943929)

locations.title: 74 - Time for a Raid!
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [73 - As Long as There's Love](#loc=943928) and ask to play against a new opponent. You'll need to have found at least 30 cards.

**Tips:**
- My winning cards were:
  - [030 - Devil's Flower Mantis](#loc=943693)
  - [001 - Cartwheel Kick](#loc=943691)
  - [009 - Omni Choke](#loc=943660)
  - [017 - Body Slam](#loc=943661)

**Reward:**
- [010 - Japanese Giant Mantis](#loc=943931)

locations.title: 75 - The Professor's Past
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [74 - Time for a Raid!](#loc=943930) and speak to the Professor.

**Tips:**
- My winning cards were:
  - [027 - Asian Giant Hornet](#loc=943700)
  - [002 - Face Masher](#loc=943659)
  - [027 - Banana Split](#loc=943702)
  - [018 - Tomoe Nage](#loc=943696)

**Reward:**
- 15,000 XP
- [008 - Last Resort](#loc=943933)

locations.title: 76 - The Professor's Past 2
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete [75 - The Professor's Past](#loc=943932) and speak to Hime inside [Club SEGA, Theater Square](#loc=942794)

**Tips:**
- My winning cards were:
  - [027 - Asian Giant Hornet](#loc=943700)
  - [002 - Face Masher](#loc=943659)
  - [027 - Banana Split](#loc=943702)
  - [018 - Tomoe Nage](#loc=943696)

**Reward:**
- 20,000 XP
- [020 - Wasp King](#loc=943935)

locations.title: 77 - Enjoying It With Everyone
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Speak to the Professor after completing [76 - The Professor's Past 2](#loc=943934)

**Tips:**
- You can only battle Masashi after collecting at least 40 cards.
- My winning cards were:
  - [003 - Empress Cicada](#loc=943703)
  - [001 - Cartwheel Kick](#loc=943691)
  - [009 - Omni Choke](#loc=943660)
  - [017 - Body Slam](#loc=943661)


**Reward:**
- 25,000 XP
- [015 - Tie Breaker](#loc=943937)

locations.title: 45 - Of Luck and Debt
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Drink at [Shellac](#loc=942773) 2-3 times. The substory will start when you enter to find a different person behind the bar.

**Tips:**
- The secret casino is beneath [Kyushu No. 1 Star](#loc=942772). You'll learn the password via [01 - The Price of an F-cup](#loc=943489) or [31 - The Yakuza's Apprentice II](#loc=943657).
- A Goddess of Children Amulet is the reward for completing [42 - The Cell Phone Plan](#loc=944129), but it can also be purchased in the [Coliseum](#loc=944183).

**Reward:**
- 50,000 Yen
- 5,000 XP

locations.title: 42 - The Cell Phone Plan
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the men standing by the vending machines.

**Tips:**
- You'll need to manually open Locker C1.
- The amulet you get as a reward can be used to complete [45 - Of Luck and Debt](#loc=943924)

**Reward:**
- Goddess of Children Amulet
- 5,000 XP

locations.title: 48 - Memories of the Bubble
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Walk past a woman standing at the edge of the [Debolah](#loc=942814) dance floor.

**Tips:**
- The fan and bodycon dress you need to buy are at [Don Quijote](#loc=942786)
  - You'll need 59,800 Yen.

**Reward:**
- Double Feathered Fans
- 15,000 XP

locations.title: 52 - The Value of 2,000 Yen
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the glasses-wearing man sitting at the bar in [Vincent](#loc=942801).

**Tips:**
- Only one bill can be held at a time; bring them back to the collector to get a new one.
- The bills can be found in these places:
  - [Yoshida Batting Center](#loc=942766) - held by the man near the arcade cabinets.
  - [Club SEGA, Theater Square](#loc=942794) - held by a man sitting near the counter.
- Held by a man on the corner of the street north-east of [Kotobuki Drugs](#loc=942785)
- Held by the clerk of [Poppo, Tenkaichi Street](#loc=942789)
- Held by a man opposite [Kazama Family Office](#loc=942806)

**Reward:**
- 20,000 Yen per bill
- 15,000 XP

locations.title: 13 - Pay It Forward
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Enter the park.

**Tips:**
- This substory is available in Chapter 4, but can only be completed in Chapter 6.
- Sake can be purchased from [M Store](#loc=942784)
- The Worn-out Coat is given to a homeless man just south of [Beam](#loc=942787)
- The glasses are given to a man outside of [Asia](#loc=942792)
- Super Strength Adhesive Tape is given to a man at the top-middle part of [West Park](#loc=942765).
- Finally, the Silver Briefcase goes to a man in the alley near [Key I5](#loc=943185).

**Reward:**
- Swiss Watch
- 1,000 XP

locations.title: 02 - My Baby's A Showgirl
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Receive a call from Yuya. May only be possible after completing [13 - Pay It Forward](#loc=943503)

**Reward:**
- Free Pass for Asia
- 20,000 XP

locations.title: 58 - In Pursuit of Pleasure
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the street corner.

**Tips:**
- You'll meet for food at [Kanrai](#loc=942779).
- You'll then go to [JeweL](#loc=942799).
- Next up is the [Coliseum](#loc=944183) - be ready for a fairly tough fight!

**Reward:**
- Shinichi Shinohara added to roster of Coliseum fighters
- 15,000 XP

locations.title: 29 - The Heart of Vandalism
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the old man standing opposite [Mach Bowl](#loc=942803).

**Reward:**
- 50,000 Yen
- 30,000 XP

locations.title: 43 - Yakuza on the Run
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Speak to the man running around this area.

**Reward:**
- [Key J5](#loc=944193)
- 30,000 XP

locations.title: 44 - Bad Boy in Blue
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the cop standing by the alley.

**Reward:**
- 70,000 Yen
- 35,000 XP

locations.title: 59 - Komaki Style: Shot Stopper
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Speak to Komaki in [West Park](#loc=942765).

**Reward:**
- Komaki Shot Stopper fighting move unlocked
- 1,000 XP

locations.title: 60 - Komaki Style: Swordsmanship
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Speak to Komaki in [West Park](#loc=942765) after completing [59 - Komaki Style: Shot Stopper](#loc=944195) and equipping a wooden katana.

**Tips:**
- You can buy a wooden katana from [Ebisu Pawn](#loc=942783).

**Reward:**
- Komaki Slash Attack fighting move unlocked
- 2,000 XP

locations.title: 61 - Komaki Style - Roundhouse Attack
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Speak to Komaki in [West Park](#loc=942765) after completing [60 - Komaki Style: Swordsmanship](#loc=944196) and acquiring the Image of an Asura.

**Tips:**
- You can buy the Image of an Asura from the [Coliseum](#loc=944183).

**Reward:**
- Komaki Roundhouse Attack fighting move unlocked
- 3,000 XP

locations.title: 05 - A Doctor's Duty
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the boy. May only be possible after completing [13 - Pay It Forward](#loc=943503)

**Tips:**
- This substory can be started in Chapter 6, but is impossible to finish until Chapter 7.
- After feeding him, bring Haruka to the boy at night.
- The doctor you need is a few buildings west of [Akaushimaru, Tenkaichi Street](#loc=942770).

**Reward:**
- 45,000 XP

locations.title: 03 - Bet on a Champ
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Bring Haruka to [Bantam](#loc=942780).

**Tips:**
- The password is "I came to take shelter from the rain".

**Reward:**
- 45,000 XP

locations.title: 41 - The B-King's Misfortune
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the group of men.

**Reward:**
- Brawler Amulet
- 50,000 XP

locations.title: 40 - The Medicine Goes Down
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the man laying in the street after completing [41 - The B-King's Misfortune](#loc=944208).

**Tips:**
- Confront the men wearing red.

**Reward:**
- 150,000 Yen
- 50,000 XP

locations.title: 39 - Kyoka and Takashi
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the man standing outside of West Park after completing [41 - The B-King's Misfortune](#loc=944208).

**Tips:**
- A sandwich can be purchased from [M Store](#loc=942784). Any kind will do.

**Reward:**
- Gambler's Binding
- 50,000 XP

locations.title: 50 - Searching for the Present
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Bring Haruka to the park.

**Tips:**
- The reward you get is determined by the presents you deliver.

**Reward:**
- Mew Shoes (if you chose the AiAi plush, Golem Tiger, Shrink-Wrapped Book, or Crossword)
- Staminan Royale (if you chose the Math Book or Car Compendium)
- 3,000 XP

locations.title: 51 - Bad Ass Dads
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Speak to the woman near the fountain in [West Park](#loc=942765).

**Tips:**
- The reward you get is determined by your final answer.

**Reward:**
- Italian Shoulder Bag (if your final answer is "Having less common sense than normal men.")
- Wild Shirt (if your final answer is "Going to a tanning salon every day." or "...I have no clue!")
- 50,000 XP

locations.title: 49 - The Rumored Party
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Visit [Stardust](#loc=942807) and speak to a host inside.

**Reward:**
- Tourmaline Bracelet
- 50,000 XP

locations.title: 37 - Gangbusters
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Pass by the men standing on the street corner.

**Reward:**
- 30,000 Yen
- 50,000 XP

locations.title: 09 - The Stalker
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the woman standing by the street after completing [37 - Gangbusters](#loc=944216)

**Reward:**
- 30,000 Yen
- 50,000 XP

locations.title: 06 - The Fake Mizuki's Truth
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Visit the Florist's office in [Purgatory](#loc=942765) after completing [05 - A Doctor's Duty](#loc=944206). Haruka cannot be with you.


**Reward:**
- 50,000 XP

locations.title: 07 - Man on a Ledge
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the crowd while Haruka is with you.

**Reward:**
- 60,000 XP

locations.title: 04 - The Yakuza's Wife
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Visit the Florist's office in [Purgatory](#loc=942765) after receiving a call from him. Haruka cannot be with you.

**Reward:**
- 59,200 XP

locations.title: 57 - Behind the Assassin
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Approach the man standing by the street. Haruka cannot be with you.

**Reward:**
- 35,000 XP

locations.title: 46 - The Last Assassin
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Complete every other substory, purchase every ability, and reach Majima rank SSS.

**Tips:**
- Tiger Drop is your best friend.
- Stock up on HP / Heat consumables
- Bring plenty of weapons, e.g Zap Guns & Spicy Knives
- Equip Gauntlets to block his knife in phase 2.

**Reward:**
- Amon Sunglasses
- 89,300 XP
